records.title: 10-K
records.text: Consolidated net sales for the year ended June 30, 2023 increased 9% to a new record of $1,823 million from the prior-year record total of $1,676 million, reflecting higher net sales for both the Retail and Foodservice segments driven by pricing to offset inflationary costs.

records.text: Over the course of the following two years, while this shift in demand was inconsistent and volatile, on balance it positively impacted our Retail segment sales volumes and negatively impacted our Foodservice segment sales volumes.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The inflationary cost environment we experienced during 2022 resulted in significantly higher input costs for our business.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income increased 26% to $141.5 million in 2023 driven by the increase in gross profit as our pricing actions served to offset the significant inflationary costs we have experienced for commodities, packaging, labor and warehousing, as well as the impact of lower restructuring and impairment charges.
